request_summary: Add InternVL2-2B and InternVL2-4B as selectable vision model backends alongside the existing Qwen2-VL backends, with a new InternVL2Backend class, config entries, recorder dispatch logic, and UI label support.

acceptance_criteria.description: invoy_sdk/vlm_backends.py exports a module-level helper `_is_internvl2_model_id(model_id: str) -> bool` that returns True when 'internvl' (case-insensitive) appears in model_id and False otherwise. Verified by importing the function and calling it with 'OpenGVLab/InternVL2-2B' (True) and 'Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct' (False).

invoy_sdk/vlm_backends.py contains a class `InternVL2Backend(VLMBackend)` whose `log_model_name` property returns the string `f'internvl2:{self.model_id}'`, whose `generate()` signature exactly matches VLMBackend.generate() (keyword-only args: prompt, image_paths, max_new_tokens, use_extractor_model=False), and whose `generate()` uses only the first image path, uses `model.chat(tokenizer, pixel_values, question, generation_config)` for inference (returning a plain string — no decode step), and returns `(None, 0.0)` when the model is not loaded or an exception occurs.

invoy_app/settings/config.py defines AVAILABLE_MODELS with exactly four entries in this order: 'Qwen2-VL 2B' -> 'Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct', 'Qwen2.5-VL 3B' -> 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct', 'InternVL2 2B' -> 'OpenGVLab/InternVL2-2B', 'InternVL2 4B' -> 'OpenGVLab/InternVL2-4B'. No other changes to config.py.

invoy_app/core/recorder.py imports `InternVL2Backend` and `_is_internvl2_model_id` from `invoy_sdk.vlm_backends`, and `_load_model_then_capture` instantiates `InternVL2Backend` when `_is_internvl2_model_id(self._config.model_id)` is True, and `Qwen2VLBackend` otherwise. The type annotation on `self._backend` is widened to `Optional[VLMBackend]` (importing `VLMBackend` from `invoy_sdk.vlm_backends`).

invoy_app/app.py `_short_model_label()` checks for 'InternVL2-4B' or 'InternVL2_4B' first (returns 'InternVL2 4B'), then 'InternVL2-2B' or 'InternVL2_2B' (returns 'InternVL2 2B'), before the existing '3B', '2B', '7B' checks. Existing Qwen label logic is unchanged.

InternVL2Backend image preprocessing uses torchvision transforms: Resize to (448, 448) with BICUBIC interpolation, ToTensor, and Normalize with IMAGENET_MEAN=(0.485, 0.456, 0.406) and IMAGENET_STD=(0.229, 0.224, 0.225). The pixel_values tensor is cast to torch.bfloat16 and moved to device before calling model.chat(). The model is loaded with AutoModel (not AutoProcessor), using torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, low_cpu_mem_usage=True, trust_remote_code=True.

out_of_scope: Do not change ACTIVITY_PROMPT or CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL in recorder.py
Do not change settings_window.py — it already reads AVAILABLE_MODELS dynamically
Do not add torchvision to requirements.txt — it is already installed as a torch dependency
Do not change any other part of app.py beyond _short_model_label()
Do not change any other part of config.py beyond AVAILABLE_MODELS
Do not modify invoy_sdk/capture.py, invoy_sdk/activity_log.py, or invoy_sdk/pipeline.py
risk_flags: recorder.py currently has `self._backend: Optional[Qwen2VLBackend]` — this type annotation MUST be changed to `Optional[VLMBackend]` and VLMBackend must be imported; failing to do so causes a type error and makes the dispatch conditional unreachable in typed checks.

The existing import block in recorder.py uses a try/except _SDK_AVAILABLE guard — InternVL2Backend and _is_internvl2_model_id must be added inside that same try block to preserve the guard pattern; importing outside will cause a NameError at runtime if invoy_sdk is absent.
InternVL2Backend must NOT use AutoProcessor (which is the Qwen path) — it uses AutoModel + AutoTokenizer with trust_remote_code=True. Mixing these will load the wrong model class.

The generate() method must wrap inference in a try/except and return (None, 0.0) on any exception — the Qwen backend uses assert statements and lets exceptions bubble up, but the spec requires InternVL2Backend to swallow exceptions with print().

_short_model_label() in app.py currently checks '2B' before any InternVL2 check — if InternVL2-2B checks are added AFTER the '2B' check, 'OpenGVLab/InternVL2-2B' will incorrectly return 'Qwen2-VL 2B'. The InternVL2 checks MUST come first.
InternVL2 inference uses device_map='auto' for GPU loading — on CPU, omit device_map and call .to(device) instead, mirroring the pattern already used in Qwen2VLBackend._ensure_loaded().

The model.chat() API returns a plain string — the Programmer must NOT attempt to decode token IDs (no processor.batch_decode call), which would cause a TypeError since the return value is already a string.
